name: AddToWorldQueue
evidence: Slot 3 of class 0x46: appends the object to the world's list at +0x1C78 (func_00152470) and sets state 0.

name: CopyPooledObject
evidence: slot 9 of class 0x46: saves the 8 bytes at 0x56C, runs CopyCollider, and restores them

name: LoadPooledObject

name: HandlePooledObjectNotification
evidence: slot 13 of class 0x46: after the base handler, kind 6 from the watched object clears it and sets state 4 with SetPooledObjectState

name: StartPooledObject
evidence: slot 16 of class 0x46: runs StartPlacedObject, then resolves the object link table D_00261CC8 with ResolveObjectLinks

name: UpdatePooledObject
evidence: Slot 17 of class 0x46: switches on the state, runs func_0014F270 in state 2 and moves to state 5 after the delay in state 4.

name: SetPooledObjectState
evidence: Stores the new state of a class 0x46 object, stamps the clock, clears the taker data when leaving state 2.

name: LaunchObjectFromPooledObject
evidence: a callback func_0014F270 passes on: gives the other object, through its slot 0x90, a velocity of the pooled object's horizontal direction (+0x150 with z cleared, normalised) times D_00261CD4 plus D_00261CD8 up, and moves the player (kind 7) to state 4/0x2B

name: UpdateHeldPooledObject
evidence: UpdatePooledObject's step in state 2, while an object holds it: finds the touching part (FindContactingPart), plays sounds and pad patterns, counts the holder's children and moves the pooled object on through SetPooledObjectState

name: InitPooledHolder
evidence: slot 0 of class 0x23: runs the base initialiser func_0013DDB8 and sets 0x6C0 to -1

name: HandlePooledHolderNotification
evidence: slot 13 of class 0x23: kind 0x14 from the state walker at 0x740 in state 0x2B7 either destroys the walker or re-poses the two held objects at 0x734 and 0x738

name: PostLoadPooledHolder
evidence: slot 15 of class 0x23: runs PostLoadPlacedObject, then copies each object of items748 found with func_0015A448 that is of kind 0x41 into items76C

name: SyncPooledHolderWithPlayer
evidence: copies the player's word at +0x24F8 into the class 0x23 holder's +0x6DC when g_player is set (StartPooledHolder calls it)

name: StartPooledHolder
evidence: slot 16 of class 0x23: resolves the link table D_00261CE0, copies four vectors from the object found for 0x6C0, starts its children and creates the state walker at 0x740 in state 0x2B7

name: UpdatePooledHolder
evidence: slot 17 of class 0x23: runs the base update and moves the state walker at 0x740 between its states 0x2B7..0x2BB by f7B0, f78C and the aim step, through SetTakerWalkerState

name: TestPooledHolderMayContact
evidence: overrides TestCollidersMayContact: returns 1 for a class 0x46 object whose taker is itself, else defers to the base

name: ReleasePooledHolder
evidence: lets go of the taken object at 0x6C8 (slots 15 and 3), sends the walker at 0x740 to 0x2B7 and destroys it, calls slot 2 of the held object at 0x734 with 7 and runs func_0013D278

name: SetPooledHolderWalkerState
evidence: sets the target state of the walker at 0x740 (unless it is already there), updating the held object's fields at 0x4C and 0x1C for states 0x2B7..0x2B9

name: UpdatePooledHolderAim
evidence: in state 0x2B8 clears the held object's +0x1C and after the delay +0x6D0 acquires a pooled object (state 0x2BA); otherwise keeps a target among the attached pooled objects (FindFirstAttachedPooledObject), aims at it (AssignAimTarget) and acquires one after the delay (state 0x2BB)

name: AcquirePooledObject
evidence: returns 1 if already holding one; else takes the head of the world's class 0x46 list at +0x1C78, sets its taker to itself, starts it, places it at the saved vectors, sets its state to 1 and keeps it at 0x6C8

name: ThrowHeldPooledObject
evidence: takes the held (or aimed-at, speed 15) object out of the holder, releases its anchors and descriptor slot 0x15 hold, and launches it from the source's position along its direction at the holder's throw speed

name: SelectEarliestPooledObject
evidence: unless one is already held at +0x6CC, takes from every item of the list D_00262708 its FindEarliestPooledChild, keeps the one with the smallest state time and sets it to state 5 with SetPooledObjectState

name: FindFirstAttachedPooledObject
evidence: returns the first of the up to 8 objects at +0x790 that IsObjectAttached and whose state is neither 3 nor 4

name: AddPooledHolderItem
evidence: appends an object to the class 0x23 holder's list at +0x748 (count +0x744, at most 8); the script built-in func_00109488 calls it

name: ResetCollectedItems
evidence: zeroes the holder's collected count +0x78C and its flag +0x7B0 (the script built-in ResetScriptCollectedItems calls it)

name: RecordCollectedItem
evidence: sets the holder's flag +0x7B0 for an object of kind 7, and appends an object of kind 0x41 that is in its list at +0x76C to the collected list at +0x790 (at most 8); the script built-in CollectScriptItem calls it

name: InitStepSequence
evidence: slot 0 of class 0x65: runs the placed-object set-up func_00123ED0, sets a flag bit and sets the two ids at +0x300 and +0x30C to -1

name: LoadStepSequence
evidence: slot 14 of class 0x65: runs the base loader func_001289C0 then reads the step list with func_00150570 into +0x2DC/+0x2E0

name: ReadSequenceSteps
evidence: reads a count, allocates count * 0x28 bytes and reads one typed step each (types 0..4 and 7 with their own fields)

name: StartStepSequence
evidence: slot 20 of class 0x65: runs the base start func_00124A48, defaults the target id, and looks the target word up in the current level entry (func_00160CA0)

name: SetStepSequenceModeOne
evidence: sets a step sequence's mode (+0x2D0) to 1, which keeps SetStepSequenceState from counting it in D_00261D38 (script built-in func_00106C50)

name: SetStepSequenceCameraMode
evidence: sets a step sequence's mode (+0x2D0) to 2, in which SetStepSequenceState's state 3 pushes camera controller 6, takes the pad select flag and lowers volume channel 9 (script built-in func_00106CF0)

name: ReadSequenceTarget
evidence: copies the word at the sequence's target pointer (+0x304) to *out

name: WriteSequenceTarget
evidence: stores value in the word at the sequence's target pointer (+0x304)

name: SetStepSequenceState
evidence: leaves the old state (1, 3, 4 or 5) with its clean-up and enters the new one with its set-up, then stamps the time at +0x2D8

name: UpdateStepSequence
evidence: slot 21 of class 0x65: runs the placed-object update, picks the next state from the current one, the pause and timeout (5 seconds) and runs func_001517C0 in state 3

name: HandleStepSequenceMessage
evidence: switches on the message type: 0..2 and 3 queue speaker, text, timing and wait flags at +0x2E8, 4..6 run actions, 7 passes a value on

name: HandleStepSequenceNotification
evidence: slot 0x44 of class 0x65: after HandlePlacedObjectNotification, notification 6 about the object at +0x2F8 clears it

name: TestStepWaitConditions
evidence: clears each wait bit of +0x2E8 whose condition has been met (speaker done, text done, timer past, input pressed) and returns whether any remain

name: SkipRemainingSteps
evidence: moves on through the later steps running only the action kinds 4, 5 and 6, then calls func_001E9570 in mode 2

name: RunStepSequence
evidence: repeats: stop while TestStepWaitConditions is pending, otherwise advance to the next step and send it to HandleStepSequenceMessage; when done calls SkipRemainingSteps

name: ShowStepSequenceText
evidence: passes a value to the object's callback slot, or with no object puts it in g_typedTextCaptionBox and pushes that box on g_elementStack (UpdateStepSequence calls it)

name: ChooseStepSequenceState
evidence: unless blocked by globals, picks state 1 or 5 (or the current one) from the target word and extra targets and calls SetStepSequenceState

name: ResetStepSequence
evidence: returns to state 0 unless the state is 1 or 3

name: AddSequenceExtraTarget
evidence: looks up an entry by name and kind and appends it to the sequence's list of up to 4 extra target words at +0x314

name: GetScatterController
evidence: returns the address of g_scatterController (func_00109488 calls it)

name: ClearScatterController
evidence: zeroes the 0x24 bytes of a scatter controller (func_00160880 calls it)

name: ResetScatterController
evidence: sets the scatter controller's count ranges (4..6, 1..3), picks its table by g_saveData's progress words and g_currentEntry's flag 2, sets the level and draws its two counts from the table's ranges

name: UpdateScatterLevelLimits
evidence: with flag 8 of D_00275B00 raises g_saveData's 0x19E4 count (func_00160C48) to the table's value for the level's band, else clamps the level to the table's range; then runs CompleteSoundNotifiers (func_001DCEA0 calls it)

name: NotifyScatterControllerLoaded
evidence: does nothing; RunPendingWorldLoad calls it with g_scatterController

name: RaiseScatterLevels
evidence: raises g_currentEntry's level (+0x0C, SetScatterLevel) by an amount times the table's rate and its second level (+0x10) by the amount times a rate chosen by g_saveData's 0x19E0 count, clamped to 0..1

name: RaiseScatterLevelForObject
evidence: raises the level by the table's +0x14, or +0x18 when the object's ordinal bit is already set in g_currentEntry's bits at +0x74, and sets that bit, counting it at +0x70

name: ResetScatterLevels
evidence: sets the level and the second level of g_currentEntry to 0 and clears its count +0x70 and its first bit byte (SetSaveNotifierState calls it)

name: ScatterObjectsAtPoint
evidence: counts down the scatter controller's two counts and scatters objects of kind 0x58 (and one of 0x57 when the second level falls) around a point with ScatterObjectsAroundCircle, redrawing the counts from the table's ranges

name: SetScatterLevel
evidence: clamps a value to the scatter controller's table range (ClampToRange) and stores it as g_currentEntry's level

name: SetListLinkOffset
evidence: stores the offset of the link pair in each item in a list's +0x08 (InitActiveSetSolver and many set-ups call it)

name: ClearList
evidence: zeroes the head and tail words of an intrusive list

name: ClearListLinks
evidence: zeroes an item's two link words (func_00127048 and func_00158F80 call it)

name: GetListLinks
evidence: returns the address of an item's link pair: the item plus the list's offset field

name: AppendToList
evidence: links the item after the list's tail through the pair at item + offset, and makes it the tail

name: PrependToList
evidence: links the item in front of the list's head, and makes it the head

name: InsertBeforeInList
evidence: inserts value before the given item (appending when it is 0, prepending when it is the head)

name: RemoveFromList
evidence: unlinks the item from its list, repairs the head and tail and moves every live iteration frame (chain D_0027B314) that points at it on to the next item

name: IsInList
evidence: true when the item's next link is set or it is the list's tail

name: IsListEmpty
evidence: returns whether the list's head is 0

name: SpliceListToEnd
evidence: moves every item of src onto the end of dst through their link pairs and clears src

name: CountListItems
evidence: follows the next links from the head and counts the items

name: InitDmaChannels
evidence: enables DMA with func_002027C8(1), then stores the channel pointer for ids 0, 1, 2, 8, 9 into the VIF0, VIF1, GIF, from-SPR and to-SPR tables; sits in the start-up function table D_002647C0

name: InitPacketBuffer
evidence: clears the open-tag and mode words, installs the table D_0024A0E0 and clears begin, cur and end

name: ClearPacketBuffer
evidence: zeroes begin, end, the open-tag pointer and the cursor

name: RewindPacketBuffer
evidence: drops the open tag and moves the cursor back to the buffer's start

name: AllocatePacketBuffer
evidence: allocates count * 16 bytes with func_0018D4B0 and sets begin, cur and end

name: AllocateQuadwordBuffer
evidence: takes count*16 bytes from AllocateFrontMemory and sets the buffer's allocated, current and end pointers to that block

name: AllocateTempPacketBuffer
evidence: allocates count * 16 bytes with func_0018D658, the call used between func_0018D608 and func_0018D6F0, and sets begin, cur and end

name: UsePacketBufferMemory
evidence: sets begin and cur to the given base and end count * 16 bytes past it

name: DetachPacketBuffer
evidence: closes the open tag, outputs the quadword count and begin pointer, then clears the buffer

name: DetachPacketBufferCopy
evidence: closes the open tag, outputs the count and begin, copies the contents with func_0018D568 into *out and clears the buffer

name: SubmitPacketBuffer
evidence: closes the open tag, starts the DMA channel with the buffer's begin (func_00202A80) and rewinds the cursor

name: BeginDmaTag
evidence: closes any open tag, writes a count tag (0x10000000) at the cursor and remembers it as the open tag whose size CloseDmaTag fills in

name: AddDmaRefTag
evidence: closes an open tag if there is one, writes a reference tag (0x40000000) with size lo and address hi, then reopens a count tag

name: AddDmaCallTag
evidence: same as AddDmaRefTag but writes a call tag (0x50000000) with the address hi

name: AddDmaReturnTag
evidence: closes the open tag and writes a return tag (0x60000000)

name: AppendPacketQuadwords
evidence: copies a number of quadwords to the packet buffer's cursor (+0x0C) and moves the cursor past them (CopyQuadwords)

name: AddDmaEndTag
evidence: closes the open tag and writes an end tag (0x70000000) at the buffer's cursor

name: CloseDmaTag
evidence: pads the cursor to 16 bytes and ORs the open tag's quadword count (distance from the tag / 16 - 1) into its first word

name: SkipDisplayListWriterSlot
evidence: slot 3 of the display-list writer's base table D_0024A0E0: does nothing

name: InitC61Object
evidence: slot 0 of class 0x61: runs InitPlacedObject only

name: BuildTexturePackets
evidence: for a texture, builds two DMA packets (one clearing/copying through its dimensions, one drawing edge quads) and stores their pointers and sizes at +0x2D4..+0x2E0

name: QueuePlacedObjectDraw
evidence: builds the placed-object transform and queues func_001533A8 as a deferred request with the object as its argument

name: DrawPlacedObjectParts
evidence: deferred draw callback queued by func_00153328: adds DMA ref tags, writes a matrix to VIF, then runs the part drawer func_00166690 for each 0x70-byte part

name: InitActiveSetSolver
evidence: clears the 0x50-byte solver record, allocates 2n items of 0x60 bytes, makes its four lists and allocates the matrix, factor, right-hand-side and solution arrays

name: ResetActiveSetSolver
evidence: empties its four lists, clears each 0x60-byte item's two floats and eight bytes and files every item in the free list at +0x30

name: AddActiveSetItem
evidence: appends an item to the active-set solver: fills the new column of every existing item's row (+0x44) with the dot product of the item's vector (+0x10) and the row's vector, appends it to the list at +0x30 and counts it (+0x4); func_00154088 and func_001BCD00 call it

name: BuildContactItemRows
evidence: for each end of a contact allocates the body's impulse rows (32 bytes per part) and fills them through body descriptor slots 58 and 59, then builds the contact's per-item axes from point velocities of the parts

name: PivotActiveSet
evidence: up to ten rounds: builds the active items' matrix, calls the factor and solve functions, then moves the item that first reaches a bound between the active, at-low, at-high lists

name: RunActiveSetSolver
evidence: moves the pending items of kind 2 into the active list, calls func_00153A50, then repeatedly takes the pending item with the most negative value (below -0.01) and pivots it in until none is left

name: AddFrictionItemsAndSolve
evidence: repeats RunActiveSetSolver, each time picking the contact whose accumulated tangential velocity is largest, pairing a bounded friction item (limit = the normal item's force times the contact's friction) with it and notifying the parts' handlers, until none is left

name: ApplySolvedImpulsesToParts
evidence: sums each active item's solved force times its rows into per-part linear and angular impulse buffers, then converts them to each part's parent-relative frame and clamps them by the linear and angular limits with ConstrainColliderVector

name: SolveActiveSetSystem
evidence: builds an active-set solver for n items with InitActiveSetSolver, loads each item's row of n words and its value, runs RunActiveSetSolver and copies the n results out of the item records
